The purchaser of FleetBoston Financial in 2004 was **JPMorgan Chase & Co.**  
At the time of that acquisition, the company’s chief executive officer was **Jamie Dimon**, who had already taken over the CEO role of JPMorgan Chase (having previously led Bank One) and has continued as CEO since 2006.
